name: What are common kitchen clearance improvements?

mainEntity.name: What are common kitchen clearance improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen clearance improvements typically involve optimizing the space between countertops, appliances, and overhead cabinets to meet safety standards and improve functionality. This can include adjusting cabinet heights, relocating appliances, or modifying countertop depths. These adjustments ensure adequate room for cooking, appliance ventilation, and comfortable movement, enhancing both the safety and usability of your kitchen space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen clearance improvements optimize space between countertops, appliances, and cabinets for safety and functionality.
